messages:
sara_eng: kicking off canary for v2.1.3 -> 5% EU now. release notes: https://redwood.ai/releases/v2.1.3 :rocket:

deploybot: ACTION: starting progressive rollout v2.1.3
- target: eu-west-1 5%
- traffic policy: latency-preferred
- rollout_id: r-3790001111

kai_sre: seeing p95 spike on embeddings-proxy in eu-west-1, was ~120ms now ~420ms over last 2m :eyes:

opsbot: Alert: embeddings-proxy-eu-west-1 - error_rate up 3.8% (baseline 0.2%) | alerts: 12 in 5m

sara_eng: @kai_sre can you paste a small query/trace? i want to see if it's KV cache miss related

kai_sre: quick trace snippet:
```
service: embeddings-proxy
route: /v1/embeddings
latency_ms: [110,130,450,470,430]
error: 503 x7
host: eu-west-1-a
```

anya_ml: hmm could be kv-cache eviction after new model variant landed, but v2.1.3 only toggles kernel selection for gru-quant. unsure why embeddings would 503

mike_pm: change window still open for another 12m. recommend PAUSE ramp -> hold at 5% and pin launch until root cause. :hand:

sara_eng: agree. pausing ramp. @deploybot execute hold and pin r-3790001111 -> pin v2.1.2 for eu-west-1

deploybot: COMMAND RECEIVED: pause-rollout r-3790001111
ROLLBACK STRATEGY: staged rollback EU to v2.1.2 (canary only), keep global hosted traffic unaffected

kai_sre: i started a quick rollback plan: drain new pods in eu-west-1-a then shift 100% of canary seats back to v2.1.2, monitoring p95 and error_rate during ops. will update in 5m

opsbot: INFO: rollback job queued (job-98432). estimated completion 3m

sara_eng: thanks. ping me if any failures. mike, do we need to open an incident?

mike_pm: not yet. if rollback fails or errors persist -> P0. For now, treat as hold + investigating. i'll update release notes with hold notice.
deploybot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE: eu-west-1 canary rolled back to v2.1.2 | job-98432 | duration 2m40s

kai_sre: metrics trending back to baseline: p95 ~130ms, error_rate 0.3% now. looks good.

anya_ml: will run a quick bisect on the kernel change flag and reproduce in staging with debug logging. assigned to me.

mike_pm: decision: keep v2.1.3 blocked for EU until root cause found. leaving change window open for follow-up patch. thanks team :thumbsup:

sara_eng: noted. closing this thread for rollout ops. will re-open when ready for reattempt.

deploybot: NOTE: rollout r-3790001111 status=paused, pinned_version=2.1.2, owner=@sara_eng
